#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,int d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+1);head=flip(head);return consume(head);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,unsigned char d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+260);head=flip(head);return consume(head);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,unsigned short d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+65540);return consume(head);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,_Bool d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}struct Node*entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta-2);return head;}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,signed char d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+255);return consume(head);}

request.source:
#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,unsigned char d,int other){while(q){q->value=q->value+d+other;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+260,delta+1);head=flip(head);return consume(head);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{int value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,unsigned char d){while(q){q->value=q->value;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,delta+260);head=flip(head);return consume(head);}

#include <stdlib.h>
struct Node{long long value;struct Node*next;};struct Node*build(int n){struct Node*head=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){struct Node*p=calloc(1,sizeof(struct Node));if(!p){return head;}p->value=i;p->next=head;head=p;}return head;}void map(struct Node*q,long d){while(q){q->value=q->value+d;q=q->next;}}struct Node*flip(struct Node*head){struct Node*prev=0;while(head){struct Node*next=head->next;head->next=prev;prev=head;head=next;}return prev;}long long consume(struct Node*head){long long total=0;while(head){struct Node*tail=head->next;total+=head->value;free(head);head=tail;}return total;}long long entry(int n,int delta){struct Node*head=build(n);map(head,4294967297LL);return consume(head);}
